dedupe_keys.name: guna spring water bottling filter wash discharge quality

description: This deposit measures discharge quality from treatment units at the Guna Spring Water Bottling Factory in Ethiopia. Bahir Dar Institute of Technology and factory collaborators describe softener, sand-filter, activated-carbon and ultrafiltration wash streams, assessed using physical, chemical and bacteriological tests. The article varies wash flow between two, four and six cubic metres per hour and sampling time between five, ten and fifteen minutes. Mendeley version 2 supplies an Excel data file and an image-document file free under CC BY 4.0. Geographic coverage is one factory in the South Gondar area; collection dates were not established. Selected operating conditions and sampling are limitations, and the review does not certify discharged water as potable. Modellers could calibrate wash-water reuse and treatment-process scenarios. model-dhi-west-wastewater-treatment-process-modelling is a related tool requiring its own process mapping. No workbook, microbiological result or image document was downloaded.
